acceptance.check: INV-HE-AUTH-FABRIC (authority at H1, severity refuse): a figure about this fabric is governed by analysis OF this fabric — {value} from a generic source is not proof
INV-HE-COMPATIBILITY (derivation at H3, severity refuse): material proposed without compatibility assessment — stronger is not better here
INV-HE-EVIDENCE-BASIS (qualifier at H3, severity refuse): historical claim without documented/inferred/assumed basis — {missing}
INV-HE-CONSENT-GATE (qualifier at H3, severity refuse): no work recommendation without consent position and reference — {missing}
INV-HE-SUBSTRATE (qualifier at H3, severity refuse): mortar strength without the substrate it must remain weaker than — {missing}
INV-HE-PROVENANCE (provenance at H3, severity refuse): forbidden derivation: {value}
INV-HE-CURRENCY (currency at H3, severity refuse): specification predates an unreported discovery — refusal, not silent acceptance

author: Cerebrum Team
description: Declarative heritage reasoning kit on the shared reasoning layer. 7 invariants declared in app/blocks/heritage/invariants.yaml across the kinds the portable spec defines (grounding, qualifier, unit_discipline, authority, provenance, currency, scope, derivation, band) and the five hooks (H0 pre-retrieval, H1 ranking, H2 tool-time, H3 answer-time, H4 export-time). Vocabulary in app/blocks/heritage/manifest.yaml. Scope refusals classify BEFORE retrieval. Fail closed: a kit that does not parse is DISABLED and refuses every statement rather than passing them through with no invariants. NO INTERVIEW HAS RUN, so every declared figure value is null and the block refuses rather than inventing one (app/blocks/heritage/KNOWN_GAPS.md). Measured by tests/blocks/test_reasoning_kits.py.

inputs.description: the operator question, classified at H0 BEFORE any retrieval
inputs.name: question

inputs.description: figures to gate: quantity, value, unit, origin, source_id, source_class, revision, qualifiers, claim_class, derivations, conditions, steps, bounds, asked_about, span, text
inputs.name: figures

inputs.description: state records by provider name, each {as_of: <epoch>}; an absent provider yields UNKNOWN, never a design-basis fallback
inputs.name: state

inputs.description: events that have happened, matched against the kit's staleness_triggers
inputs.name: events

inputs.description: subset of H0..H4 to run; all five by default, because a partial sweep is a silent coverage gap
inputs.name: hooks

name: heritage_kit

outputs.description: pass | annotated | flagged | refused, with findings, blocked_reason, hooks_run, retrieval_permitted, interview_status, unfilled_figures, unmeasured_invariants, ships and kit_disabled
outputs.name: verdict
